paragraphs: Via sells software and operating services for public transportation, working with the agencies and cities that run it. The company says it works with more than 700 partners around the world, from rural counties to large transit agencies.

Its on demand microtransit is pitched for first and last mile connections and for places with little transit service. For paratransit, the system optimizes routes and taps other accessible modes when they fit. An eligibility tool automates paratransit applications, approvals, and renewals. A planning product, Remix, is for visualizing data and testing network concepts before a redesign goes live. A student transit product provides scheduling and routing software meant to get every student to school on time.

Via also runs service itself under what it calls a transportation as a service model, rather than only supplying software. Its site carries comments from riders, mayors, agency leaders, planners, and dispatchers. A newer offering, Via Intelligence, is described as giving city and agency leaders recommendations and automations to lift efficiency and service performance.
